summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, building sensor-data pipelines in Python and C++ across imaging, depth estimation, and embedded sensing. Designed a wavelet-based denoising and depth-profiling inspection pipeline at BARC (PSNR 86, ±8% depth error) and a camera plus ToF sensor perception system on NVIDIA Jetson. Strong in computer vision, signal processing, PyTorch, and OpenCV, with embedded C firmware on STM32.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.
Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper close at 25 mm) via TCA9548A I2C mux, fusing vision and depth sensing for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated with zero collisions across 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 firmware in bare-metal C with timer-triggered ADC scan conversions and a low-level I2C driver; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate.
